Refresh package lists before installing packages.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value         |
| ------------ | ------------- |
| Priority     | `900000`      |
| Dependencies | `pkg-cleanup` |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set. Dependencies include
other recipes; their priorities determine execution order.

## Behavior

Runs early and includes pkg-cleanup as a dependency, so temporary package
metadata is removed after the other recipes finish.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/pkg-update"]
```
